entities.name: Lord Zangari
entities.description: A human noble of Fiora whose schemes caused his downfall; he ordered a murderous music box for his wife and died from a trapped broach.

entities.name: Sydri
entities.description: An artificer unaffiliated with the Black Rose who builds untraceable assassination devices.

entities.name: Aribelle
entities.description: Zangari's wife, the target of his plot.

entities.name: Iolanni
entities.description: Young widow and Zangari's mistress who tipped him off to Sydri.

entities.name: Lady Tirelli
entities.description: Noblewoman who told Zangari of his wife's gossip.

entities.name: Earl Bartolotti
entities.description: Host of the ball at his mansion.

entities.name: Black Rose
entities.description: Group Sydri is not affiliated with.

events.summary: At a ball Lady Tirelli tells Zangari his wife is spreading word of his business misfortune; he leaves angry.
events.quote: he left the party early, alone

events.summary: Iolanni tips Zangari about the artificer Sydri.
events.quote: Iolanni tipped Zangari of the artificer Sydri

events.summary: Zangari orders from Sydri a music box that would give his wife a heart attack.
events.quote: gave her the order to create a musical box that would give his wife a heart attack

events.summary: Zangari returns with the items and admires a boar's head broach that Sydri says is not for sale.
events.quote: the boar's head broach was a custom order for another client and was not for sale

events.summary: Sydri explains how the music box will kill Aribelle on the third hearing.
Zangari threatens Sydri, and she gives him the music box and the broach as a gift.
events.quote: Zangari greedily snatched both boxes and left.

events.summary: Zangari pins the broach on his cape, pricks his finger, laughs uncontrollably and dies feeling cold.
events.quote: There was a brief flash of pain as he had somehow managed to prick his finger on the broach.

relations.quote: He went straight to his mistress, the young widow Iolanni
he wondered to himself why he was feeling so cold on such a warm summer night
